records.title: 10-Q
records.text: On a consolidated basis, Mileage Plan other revenue increased $50 million, or 12%, in the first nine months of 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: While passenger traffic rose 11% due to increased departures flown by larger aircraft in our Mainline fleet, softening of the demand environment led to a 10% decrease in yield following record highs in the prior year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Fuel gallons consumed increased 10%, driven by increased capacity.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: These decreases were partially offset by a $134 million increase in other operating expense categories.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the first nine months of 2023, net cash provided by operating activities was $1.1 billion, compared to $1.4 billion in 2022.
